title: Deprecate legacy stream shims; add credential lookup facade and unify SDK iterables
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduce Credential Lookup Facade to unify auth across Python/TS/Go SDKs; deprecate legacy stream shims. Non-breaking ergonomics improvements; shims remain for one release. Bump SDKs: py 3.9.14 -> 3.10.0, ts 1.27.0 -> 1.28.0, go v1.8.0 -> v1.9.0.
description: Context: Multiple SDK consumers reported subtle differences in auth lookup timing and streaming iterator shapes across languages. The legacy 'stream shims' layer introduced in earlier rollouts has become a maintenance burden and makes cross-language parity work harder. Motivation: Reduce duplicated auth lookup code, surface a single lightweight facade for credential resolution that all SDKs call into, and simplify streaming APIs to a single async iterator/pull-generator mapping with clearer backpressure hints. What this PR does: 1) Adds a Credential Lookup Facade (sdk/common/cred_lookup) that centralizes token resolution, TTL jitter logic, and prefetch hints used by the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. 2) Reworks streaming surface so each SDK exports a single ergonomic async/pull iterator that maps to the runtime streaming protocol; legacy shims (StreamShimV1) are deprecated and left as compatibility wrappers that call the new facade. 3) Adds a small migration compatibility layer for applications that relied on StreamShimV1 side effects; the layer emits deprecation warnings and forwards calls. 4) Harmonizes default retry profiles for auth failures when streaming (fast-fail then background prefetch) and documents new default presets. 5) Bumps SDK versions and updates changelogs and examples in the quickstarts repo. Testing and validation: unit tests across all three SDKs, end-to-end smoke tests using the live test matrix, and cross-language parity test harness; fixed two flaky tests related to heartbeat timing. Rollout plan: merged to main and will be published behind feature flags for hosted customers for two weeks, then SDK releases will flip the default. Migration notes: existing apps continue to work with the provided shim; consumers should switch to the new iterator surface and call cred_lookup.lookup(tokenHints) for advanced prefetch semantics. Backwards compatibility window: one release cycle for the shim; plan to remove StreamShimV1 in three months with a dedicated deprecation announcement.

review_comments: Javier Morales: Overall this looks good, thanks for consolidating. Two asks: (1) can we expose a public TypeScript type for the prefetch hints? (2) Add a short example showing swapping prefetch strategy at runtime.
Maya Chen (author): Added PrefetchHints type in ts SDK and included a small runtime example under sdk-examples/streaming/ts/example_prefetch.ts. Responded to both asks in the final commit.

merge: squash and merge by Priya Natarajan
notes_on_migration: Developers should: 1) switch to the new iterator exports (Python: StreamingIterator, TS: createAsyncStream, Go: StreamIterator) and call cred_lookup.lookup when they need advanced prefetching; 2) remove StreamShimV1 usage after one release; 3) opt into the new retry profile via SDK config: { authRetry: 'prefetchThenFail' } to get the new behavior. Backward shim emits deprecation warnings logged once per process.
